Privacy Policy

Muhammad Decoration aap ki maloomat ki hifazat ko ahmiyat deta hai.

Hum kya maloomat lete hain

Booking aur contact form mein jo naam, phone number aur event ki tafseel aap likhte hain, sirf wohi.

Maloomat ka istemal

Yeh maloomat website par save nahi hoti. Form bharne ke baad ek WhatsApp message tayyar hota hai jo aap apne WhatsApp se Muhammad Decoration ko bhejte hain. Hum is maloomat se aap se rabta karte hain aur booking ki tafseel tay karte hain. Hum aap ki maloomat kisi teesre ko nahi bechte.

Dusri services

Website par WhatsApp, Google Maps, Google Fonts aur social media (TikTok, Facebook, Instagram, YouTube) ki services istemal hoti hain. In ki apni privacy policies hoti hain.
